fusions.name: Branching Quill
fusions.desc: Flings a quill into the first enemy it meets for 7 damage. It then branches to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 70% of that. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Twin Gales
fusions.desc: Sends 2 gusts out in a wide spread, each dealing 9 damage and driving what it hits back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Second Bearing
fusions.desc: Looses a second falcon for 12 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it strikes an enemy within 5 tiles and deals 4 damage.

fusions.name: Parted Course
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a second bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
